sentences.en: Welcome back to our second drink of Did I Stutter?
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到我们的第二杯“我刚才没说清楚吗？”节目？

sentences.en: I wanted to kick us off, Jenna, because we got a lot of mail about this episode.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我想由我先开头，因为我们收到了很多关于这一集的来信。

sentences.en: Many people wrote in to say that the phrase, did I stutter, is offensive and should not be used.
sentences.zh: 许多人写信来说，“我刚才没说清楚吗？”这个短语具有冒犯性，不应该使用。

sentences.en: Some people said that while they could see a buffoon like Michael Scott using this phrase,
sentences.zh: 有些人说，虽然他们能理解像迈克尔·斯科特这样的滑稽人物会用这个短语，

sentences.en: they were surprised that Stanley used it, and it's the title of the episode.
sentences.zh: 但他们很惊讶斯坦利竟然会用，而且这还是这一集的标题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that's all valid.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得这些看法都有道理。

sentences.en: Yeah, I do too.
sentences.zh: 对，我也这么觉得。

sentences.en: It's definitely an outdated phrase for sure.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个过时的短语。

sentences.en: And, you know, it makes me think of something else from my childhood that people also used to do if you couldn't hear them.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这让我想起了我童年时别的经历，如果别人听不清你说话，人们以前也会这样做。

sentences.en: Like, if they said something and you said what?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果他们说了什么，而你说了“啊？”

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Because that's what happens in the episode.
sentences.zh: 因为这一集里就是这样的情节。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then Stanley's like, did I stutter?
sentences.zh: 然后斯坦利就说：“我刚才没说清楚吗？”

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Another thing that someone might do is sort of, like, mimic the vocal pattern of a deaf person,
sentences.zh: 别人可能会做的另一件事是，有点像是在模仿聋哑人的发音模式，

sentences.en: like, to mock you for not being able to hear them or whatever.
sentences.zh: 比如，嘲笑你听不见他们说话之类的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, you know, my sister wears hearing aids.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你知道的，我姐姐戴助听器。

sentences.en: So did my grandfather and my aunt and uncle were deaf.
sentences.zh: 我爷爷也是，我的叔叔和阿姨都是聋哑人。

sentences.en: And it always kind of, like, I don't know, I didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 而且这总是让我觉得，怎么说呢，我不太喜欢这样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's like it's making this—it's making a joke, making light of this.
sentences.zh: 这就好像是把这个当成——把它当成一个笑话，对这事儿开玩笑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I mean, it just—I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这只是——我不知道。

sentences.en: But that is something that we have phased out as well now.
sentences.zh: 但这也是我们现在已经淘汰的东西。

sentences.en: And I'm glad we have.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我们淘汰了它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And also good that we have phased out this phrase.
sentences.zh: 而且很高兴我们也淘汰了这个短语。

sentences.en: Because I don't hear people say that anymore.
sentences.zh: 因为我再也没听到有人这么说了。

sentences.en: I don't either.
sentences.zh: 我也没有。

sentences.en: And I'm really glad everyone wrote in.
sentences.zh: 我真的很高兴大家写信来。

sentences.en: Thank you, guys.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家，伙计们。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you.
sentences.zh: 对，谢谢你们。

sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，我有很多朋友，我有很多员工，他们基本上是同一拨人。

sentences.en: So if I lose an employee, I am also losing a friend, and I don't want to lose two friends.

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: Oh, sad Michael.
sentences.zh: 噢，难过的迈克尔。

sentences.en: Most of them are along the same vein of, like, him just trying to perform for the camera and thinking he's really hilarious.
sentences.zh: 它们大多数都差不多，就是他试图在镜头前表现自己，觉得自己特别搞笑。

sentences.en: But I thought that one was, like, aw.
sentences.zh: 但我觉的那一个真是，哎呀。

sentences.en: Well, we also got a fun catch from Taylor in Vancouver, British Columbia.
sentences.zh: 对了，我们还收到了来自不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华的泰勒发来的一条有趣的投稿。

sentences.en: Taylor said, I noticed something.
sentences.zh: 泰勒说，我注意到了一个现象。

sentences.en: It's not an old tech alert, per se, but it is a, quote, out-of-date thing, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 它本身算不上什么旧科技警报，但我想它算是一个过时的东西吧。

sentences.en: When Kevin asked Pam to say, quote, those will be due back on Wednesday because she is wearing glasses,
sentences.zh: 当凯文让帕姆说，那些书周三就要还了，因为她戴着眼镜时，

sentences.en: I noticed that I haven't had an actual person say when my library books are due back in so long.
sentences.zh: 我发现我已经好久没遇到过真人来告诉我图书馆的书什么时候该还了。

sentences.zh: 现在都是机器在办理借书了，至少在我们图书馆是这样。

sentences.en: That's so true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Yes, I volunteered at the library, you know, at the elementary school when my kids were little.
sentences.zh: 对，我以前在我孩子还小的时候，在小学图书馆当过志愿者。

sentences.en: This was a very coveted volunteer spot, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这可是一个非常抢手的志愿者岗位。

sentences.en: There was only two parents that could volunteer, and I snagged one of the spots, and I coveted it.
sentences.zh: 只有两个家长能去当志愿者，我抢到了其中一个名额，我可稀罕了。

sentences.en: Matt, I believe you are the library volunteer at your kids' school.

sentences.en: Is this correct?
sentences.zh: 对吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.zh: 我等了好几年才当上图书馆志愿者。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh, Matt.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，马特。

sentences.en: It's such a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可真是一件大事。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a good gig.
sentences.zh: 对，这可是个好差事。

sentences.en: So you have to pay your dues.
sentences.zh: 所以你得论资排辈。

sentences.en: You have to pay your dues.
sentences.zh: 你得付出代价。

sentences.en: You have to kind of lobby for it.
sentences.zh: 你得为此去争取一番。

sentences.zh: 我直到四年级才当上。

sentences.en: I don't know about you.
sentences.zh: 你们呢，我不知道。

sentences.en: Well, I'm with my youngest, and she's in kindergarten,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是陪着我最小的孩子，她现在上幼儿园，

sentences.en: but that took a few years of, like, you know, campaigning with the older kids.
sentences.zh: 但这之前也是经过了几年给大孩子当志愿者之类的铺垫。

sentences.en: So, yeah, no, I'm in now.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，没错，我现在进去了。

sentences.en: You're in early.
sentences.zh: 你进去得挺早。

sentences.en: I went every Thursday, and I was there for story time, and I also helped restock the books.
sentences.zh: 我每个星期四都去，我去那里听故事时间，我还帮忙把书放回书架。

sentences.en: And I would scan books in for kids when they came in to return something, you know?
sentences.zh: 当孩子们来还书时，我会帮他们扫描书籍，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And it is.
sentences.zh: 确实是这样。

sentences.en: It has a little barcode, and you have, like, the little bing, you know,
sentences.zh: 上面有个小条形码，然后你就会听到那种“哔”的一声，你知道的，

sentences.en: little zappy thing.
sentences.zh: 那种小小的扫码枪。

sentences.en: What do you call it?
sentences.zh: 那个叫什么来着？

sentences.en: But you wouldn't remind people when their books were due verbally?
sentences.zh: 但你们不会口头提醒别人图书到期了吗？

sentences.en: You get an email, lady.
sentences.zh: 大姐，你会收到一封电子邮件的。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: You get an email.
sentences.zh: 你会收到一封邮件。

sentences.en: So now these are kids in elementary school.
sentences.zh: 所以现在这些都是小学的孩子。

sentences.en: So, Matt, I don't know how you guys are doing it,
sentences.zh: 所以，马特，我不知道你们是怎么做的，

sentences.en: but they would get an email from the libraries, you know,
sentences.zh: 但他们会收到图书馆发来的邮件，你知道的，

sentences.en: at blah, blah, blah library school, right?
sentences.zh: 在什么什么图书馆学校，对吧？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: That would just say, your child has a book that has been out for three months.
sentences.zh: 邮件会说，你的孩子有一本书已经借出三个月了。

sentences.en: It's on arachnids, and it's due back or something.
sentences.zh: 那是一本关于蛛形纲动物的书，该归还了什么的。

sentences.en: I feel like Taylor in Vancouver is saying that there's not even a person there,
sentences.zh: 我觉得温哥华的泰勒在说那里甚至都没有人，

sentences.en: that it's almost like a self-checkout, like the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 几乎就像自助结账一样，就像杂货店那样。

sentences.en: Well, this is at school.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是在学校。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, you know, kids need a person.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，孩子们需要一个真人。

sentences.en: But I'm sure all of your notifications are you.
sentences.zh: 但我敢肯定，所有的通知都是你发出的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: They scan their card, and it pops up.
sentences.zh: 他们刷一下卡，信息就弹出来了。

sentences.en: And if they have—I'm with the kindergartners, so if they have two books at home,
sentences.zh: 如果他们有——我是带幼儿园的，所以如果他们家里有两本书，

sentences.en: I say, sorry, Joshua, you can't check out a book this week.

sentences.en: Please go sit down.
sentences.zh: 请回座位去坐好。

sentences.en: You have to say no to the little kids.

sentences.en: Oh, I love it.

sentences.en: That's my favorite part.
sentences.zh: 那是我最喜欢的部分。

sentences.en: That's my favorite part.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是工作的一部分。

sentences.en: It might be why you secured the job, Matt.

sentences.en: I think so.

sentences.zh: 你可以扮演黑脸。

sentences.en: I also, Matt, oddly enjoyed restocking books.
sentences.zh: 马特，奇怪的是我还挺喜欢把书重新上架的。

sentences.en: Did you enjoy that?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢那个吗？

sentences.en: Is that part of your job description?
sentences.zh: 那是你工作职责的一部分吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I prefer the scanning and beeping and interacting with the children,
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢扫描、哔哔叫以及和孩子们互动，

sentences.en: but it is kind of Zen.
sentences.zh: 但这也算是一种禅意吧。

sentences.en: You do, and it took me a while.
sentences.zh: 确实是这样，而且我花了好一会儿。

sentences.en: I'm like, oh, and then by the end, I had the layout of the library,

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.

sentences.zh: 好吧，我想迈克尔终于要小心翼翼地走到斯坦利的办公桌前了，而且基本上是在斯坦利甚至还没道歉之前就原谅了斯坦利。

sentences.zh: 我觉得斯坦利忍受迈克尔已经很多年了，他现在是彻底受够了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Does Stanley report to anyone else besides Michael?
sentences.zh: 除了迈克尔，斯坦利还向其他人汇报工作吗？

sentences.en: And this is when Dwight gets out his very extensive, very hilarious employee org chart.
sentences.zh: 就在这个时候，德怀特拿出了他那份内容详尽、极其搞笑的员工组织结构图。

sentences.en: It's so elaborate.
sentences.zh: 做得太精致了。

sentences.en: It was really well made.
sentences.zh: 真的制作得很精良。

sentences.en: He has a, like, tripod he sets it on.
sentences.zh: 他甚至还拿了个三脚架把图表支在上面。

sentences.en: There's like an overlay.
sentences.zh: 上面还有透明覆盖层呢。

sentences.en: I mean, Jenna, this thing was not cheap.
sentences.zh: 我是说，珍娜，这东西可不便宜。

sentences.zh: 嗯，布伦特告诉我们，整个编剧团队在这张组织结构图上投入了大量的时间和精力，他们当时还盘算着，等这集播出后，

sentences.en: And unfortunately, though, the poster did not become the runaway bestseller they had hoped it would be.
sentences.zh: 不过遗憾的是，这张海报并没有像他们期望的那样成为畅销爆款。

sentences.en: However, Kent Sabornak sent me a picture of it and we will put it in the pod so you can really unpack it if you'd like.

sentences.en: Yeah, I looked at that last night and the detail of the menstruation cycles of the women.
sentences.zh: 对，我昨晚看了，上面还有女员工经期周期的细节呢。

sentences.en: You know, Dwight has shared that he clocks all of that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，德怀特曾说过他把这些都记录下来了。

sentences.en: Well, he wasn't kidding.
sentences.zh: 好吧，他可不是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: Angela, we got a fan question about this scene.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们收到了一条关于这个场景的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: At 9 minutes, 34 seconds, did Rain improvise touching Michael's face with his pointer?
sentences.zh: 在9分34秒的时候，雷恩是用指挥棒触碰迈克尔的脸这一幕是即兴发挥吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes, he did.
sentences.zh: 是的，他是即兴发挥的。

sentences.en: And they could not get through it.
sentences.zh: 他们当时根本拍不下去。

sentences.en: They were cracking up something so sort of delicate and intimate about Dwight touching Michael's face with that metal pointer.
sentences.zh: 他们笑得不行，德怀特用金属指挥棒触碰迈克尔的脸这个动作，有一种说不出的微妙和亲密感。

sentences.en: And those two fellas were just disintegrating into laughter.
sentences.zh: 然后这两个家伙就笑得前仰后合。

sentences.en: It's in the bloopers.
sentences.zh: 花絮里有这一段。

sentences.en: It's so fun to watch.
sentences.zh: 看起实在是太好玩了。

sentences.en: Justin said before they started the scene, they had to decide whether or not Rain would have that metal pointer or a laser pointer.
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀说在开拍这场戏之前，他们得决定雷恩是拿那个金属指挥棒还是激光笔。

sentences.en: And he's so glad.
sentences.zh: 他太庆幸了。

sentences.en: I'm so glad they gave him the metal pointer.
sentences.zh: 我也庆幸他们给了他金属指挥棒。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Brent said that after Rain improvised it once, they loved it and they had him do it again.
sentences.zh: 布伦特说，在雷恩即兴发挥了一次后，大家都非常喜欢，于是让他又演了一遍。

sentences.en: And it took over seven takes before they got even three seconds of usable footage.
sentences.zh: 结果拍了七次以上，才勉强得到了三秒钟能用的镜头。

sentences.en: And that's what you see in the episode was like take number eight.
sentences.zh: 正片里你看到的差不多是第八条。

sentences.zh: 好了，镜头回到前台，凯文正在称赞潘的眼镜。

sentences.en: I mean, they're kind of a turn on for him.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这对他来说有点像是一种挑逗。

sentences.en: Jenna, there's a lot more in the script.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，剧本里其实还有很多内容。

sentences.zh: 事实上，凯文说你现在基本上和他是一个级别的了。

sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这场戏拍了好几个备选版本。

sentences.en: We were laughing so hard.

sentences.en: And Pam's like, no, no.

sentences.en: Oh, I saw it.
sentences.zh: 哦，我看到了。

sentences.en: It's not just on his computer.

sentences.en: You can see him moving the car.
sentences.zh: 你能看到他在挪动那辆车。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: He's full on playing.
sentences.zh: 他完全是在玩。

sentences.zh: 但凯文和帕姆之间的这次互动，将导致帕姆在今天剩下的时间里把眼镜摘下来。

sentences.en: She's done.
sentences.zh: 她不干了。

sentences.en: She's sick of the comments.
sentences.zh: 她受够了那些评论。

sentences.en: She's just going to not see.
sentences.zh: 她干脆选择什么也看不见。

sentences.en: But how bad is this woman's vision?
sentences.zh: 但这个女人的视力到底有多差？

sentences.zh: 因为她摘下了眼镜，然后珍娜，电话铃响了，她很难找到话筒的手柄。

sentences.en: There is a talking head that did not make it in the episode.

sentences.zh: 帕姆在访谈里说她的视力是20比400。

sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我得告诉你，法定盲人标准是20比200或更糟。

sentences.zh: 所以如果不戴眼镜或隐形眼镜，帕姆会被视为法定盲人。

sentences.en: So it doesn't really track that Pam can't see the phone.

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: So maybe we didn't research her eyesight properly.

sentences.en: And the physicality of your comedy in this episode is fantastic.

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.zh: 珍娜，在剧本里——这不在被删减的片段里，但在剧本里——

sentences.en: Michael turns to the cameras and says, you two cameras out of here.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔转向摄像机说，你们两个摄像机也给我滚出去。

sentences.en: Everybody.
sentences.zh: 所有人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And that's why at 18 minutes, 17 seconds, you see the cameras sneak back in.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在18分17秒时，你会看到摄像机又悄悄溜了回来。

sentences.en: It's because in the script, Michael told them to get out.
sentences.zh: 因为在剧本里，迈克尔让他们滚出去。

sentences.en: I loved that move.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个桥段。

sentences.en: I loved it because when Michael is alone with Stanley or thinks he's alone with Stanley, he gets really vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它，因为当迈克尔独自面对斯坦利，或者以为自己和斯坦利独处时，他会变得非常脆弱。

sentences.en: There's tears in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他的眼里含着泪水。

sentences.en: And he says, why do you pick on me?
sentences.zh: 他说，你为什么总是针对我？

sentences.en: Like, why do you pick on me like this?
sentences.zh: 就像，你为什么非要这样针对我？

sentences.en: And it's really vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 那真的是一种脆弱的展现。

sentences.en: And Stanley, very matter of fact, he says, I don't respect you.
sentences.zh: 而斯坦利非常实事求是地说，我不尊重你。

sentences.en: And then I felt like Michael had such an honest moment that could not have happened if the cameras were there, where he says, fine, I accept that.
sentences.zh: 然后我觉得迈克尔有一个非常坦诚的时刻，如果摄像机在场的话是绝不可能发生的，他说道，好吧，我接受这一点。

sentences.en: You don't respect me.
sentences.zh: 你对我不尊重。

sentences.en: I accept it.
sentences.zh: 我接受。

sentences.en: But you can't talk to me like that here.
sentences.zh: 但你不能在这里这样对我说话。

sentences.en: I am your boss.
sentences.zh: 我是你的老板。

sentences.en: And it just cannot be done.
sentences.zh: 而且这绝对不行。

sentences.en: And I agree with you, Angela.
sentences.zh: 我同意你的看法，安吉拉。

sentences.en: Anytime Michael knows the cameras are there, he can't help but perform in some way for them.
sentences.zh: 只要迈克尔知道镜头在拍，他就忍不住要在镜头前表现一番。

sentences.en: And so I feel like we're seeing a side of Michael Scott that can only be seen when he doesn't know the cameras are there.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉我们看到了迈克尔·斯科特只有在不知道镜头在拍时才会展现的一面。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And that was such a fun part of our show, playing with who are our characters when we know the cameras are there and when we don't.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们节目非常有趣的一部分，探讨当知道镜头在拍和不知道镜头在拍时，我们的角色都是什么样子的。

sentences.en: And I loved that we got to reveal these little different parts of ourselves in these different ways.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我们能以各种不同的方式展现出自己不同的小侧面。

sentences.en: Oh, me too.
sentences.zh: 哦，我也是。

sentences.en: It made the show so rich, right?
sentences.zh: 这让节目变得如此丰富，对吧？

sentences.en: It's cool.
sentences.zh: 很酷。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: They have this moment of resolution.
sentences.zh: 他们有这样一个达成和解的时刻。

sentences.en: They're like, fine.
sentences.zh: 他们好像在说，好吧。

sentences.en: We now know our rules of engagement, right?
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道了彼此的交往规则，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: They shake hands.
sentences.zh: 他们握手。

sentences.en: Done.
sentences.zh: 搞定。

sentences.en: This leads to Michael having a talking head.
sentences.zh: 这引出了迈克尔的一段单采。

sentences.en: He's really stuck.
sentences.zh: 他真的陷进去了。

sentences.en: On the idea of respect, getting no respect.
sentences.zh: 纠结于“尊重”这个概念，觉得自己完全得不到尊重。

sentences.en: And this just sends his brain into Rodney Dangerfield land.
sentences.zh: 这让他的大脑直接进入了罗德尼·丹格菲尔德的世界。

sentences.en: So he's going to do some real kind of like off-the-cuff Rodney Dangerfield impressions,
sentences.zh: 所以他要做一些即兴的罗德尼·丹格菲尔德模仿秀，

sentences.en: which morphs into a Jeff Foxworthy impression and then Borat and then Jerry Seinfeld and then back to Rodney Dangerfield again.
sentences.zh: 接着演变成杰夫·福克斯沃西的模仿秀，然后是波拉特，然后是杰瑞·宋飞，最后又回到了罗德尼·丹格菲尔德。

sentences.en: It's a pretty epic talking head.
sentences.zh: 这是一段相当史诗级的单采。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Well, you know, Jenna, that talking head, that whole Rodney Dangerfield comic riff is not in the shooting draft.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你知道的，那段单采，整段罗德尼·丹格菲尔德的喜剧即兴并不是拍摄剧本里的。

sentences.en: It's a whole other talking head.
sentences.zh: 那是完全不同的另一段单采。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哼。

sentences.en: So I have to imagine they handed Steve a whole bunch of alts.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜他们塞给史蒂夫一大堆备选台词。

sentences.en: They would do that to us, right?
sentences.zh: 他们也会对我们这么做，对吧？

sentences.en: And this is the one that they picked because that is not the one in the script.
sentences.zh: 而这是他们选中那版，因为剧本里可不是这个。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Well, I liked this one.
sentences.zh: 不过我很喜欢这一版。

sentences.en: I did, too.
sentences.zh: 我也一样。

sentences.en: And I have to think Steve improvised a little.
sentences.zh: 而且我猜史蒂夫稍微即兴发挥了一下。

sentences.en: I think it was on the page, but I can sort of see Steve doing his thing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得剧本上是有的，但我能想象到史蒂夫在展现他自己的风格。

sentences.en: I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 肯定的。

sentences.en: However, while that talking head was happening, everyone else is in the parking lot, you know, they're heading home.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在那段单采进行的同时，其他所有人都在停车场，你知道的，他们准备回家了。

sentences.en: There is a wrap-up scene of the Dwight, Andy, Angela love triangle.
sentences.zh: 有一个关于德怀特、安迪和安吉拉三角恋的收尾场景。

sentences.en: It's in the shooting draft, and it didn't make it to the deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 它在拍摄剧本里，但没有被剪进删除片段中。

sentences.en: But Andy and Angela walk to the car.
sentences.zh: 安迪和安吉拉走向汽车。

sentences.en: They pass by Dwight, who is scraping off a Cornell sticker from the back window of the Xterra.
sentences.zh: 他们从德怀特身边走过，德怀特正在刮掉Xterra后车窗上的康奈尔大学贴纸。

sentences.en: And Andy says, goodbye, old friend.
sentences.zh: 安迪说，再见，老朋友。

sentences.en: May all your roads be downhill and the wind be on your back windshield.
sentences.zh: 愿你前路皆是下坡，顺风常拂后挡风玻璃。

sentences.en: And Angela's like, Andy.
sentences.zh: 然后安吉拉说，安迪。

sentences.en: And Andy says, I can't believe Dwight would do me like that.
sentences.zh: 安迪说，我真不敢相信德怀特会对我做出这种事。

sentences.en: He took advantage of my kindness.
sentences.zh: 他利用了我的善良。

sentences.en: And Angela says, he didn't take advantage of you.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉说，他没有利用你。

sentences.en: He bested you.
sentences.zh: 他战胜了你。

sentences.en: You were bested.
sentences.zh: 你被他击败了。

sentences.en: And then he tries to put his arm around her, and she shoves it away.
sentences.zh: 然后他想搂住她，被她一把推开了。

sentences.en: And she looks at Dwight like he's super hot.
sentences.zh: 她看着德怀特的眼神，就像觉得他超级性感一样。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇哦。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对啊。

sentences.en: Well, Angela, we should just call these deleted scenes feisty in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 好吧，安吉拉，我们干脆把这些删减片段叫作停车场里的辣妹吧。

sentences.en: Because I know that over by Pam and Jim's car, there is a scene that we shot that I believe is in the deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道在潘和吉姆的车旁，我们拍过一个片段，我记得就在删减片段里。

sentences.en: Where Jim tells Pam the truth about Ryan and what Ryan said to him and that he's gunning for him to maybe get fired or put him on notice.
sentences.zh: 吉姆在那里向潘坦白了关于瑞安的真相，以及瑞安对他说的话，说瑞安正处心积虑想让他被炒鱿鱼或者给他记过警告。

sentences.en: And Pam is not having it.
sentences.zh: 而潘可不吃这一套。

sentences.en: Oh, I titled it Pam's pissed.
sentences.zh: 噢，我给它起名叫“潘发飙了”。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Sam, you got to play that clip.
sentences.zh: 山姆，你得把那个片段放一下。

sentences.en: Hey, what really happened today?
sentences.zh: 嘿，今天到底发生什么事了？

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你什么意思？

sentences.en: I mean, I don't need my glasses to know when something's stressing you out.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不用戴眼镜也看得出什么时候有什么事让你压力山大。

sentences.en: What happened today?
sentences.zh: 今天发生什么了？

sentences.en: Ryan is trying to get rid of me.
sentences.zh: 瑞安想甩掉我。

sentences.en: He came in today to give me an official warning about my job performance.
sentences.zh: 他今天来给我下达了关于我工作表现的正式警告。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: God, he's such a creep.
sentences.zh: 天哪，他真是个讨厌鬼。

sentences.en: That really pisses me off.
sentences.zh: 这真让我火大。

sentences.en: I'm going to bash his face in.
sentences.zh: 我要把他的脸砸扁。

sentences.en: I'm going to bash his face in with a stale bagel.
sentences.zh: 我要用一块放硬了的百吉饼把他的脸砸扁。

sentences.en: Then I'm going to throw a rock at his car.
sentences.zh: 然后我要朝他的车扔块石头。

sentences.en: Come on, we're going to New York right now.
sentences.zh: 走吧，我们现在就去纽约。

sentences.en: I'm driving.
sentences.zh: 我开车。

sentences.en: If I hit him without my glasses, I don't think it's a crime.
sentences.zh: 如果我不戴眼镜撞到他，我觉得这应该不算犯罪吧。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: God, I should have told you all about this sooner.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我应该早点把这些都告诉你们的。

sentences.en: What a jerk.
sentences.zh: 真是个混蛋。

sentences.en: What a jerk.
sentences.zh: 真是个混蛋。

sentences.en: Can you imagine if they had left in the sex talk between Jim and Pam up at the top?
sentences.zh: 你能想象如果他们把一开始吉姆和潘之间关于性的话题保留下来会怎样吗？

sentences.en: And then this scene of Pam saying she's going to throw a rock at Ryan or maybe hit him with her car.
sentences.zh: 然后接着是这个场景：潘说她要向瑞安扔石头，或者可能用车载着去撞他。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And in the shooting draft, it was much shorter.
sentences.zh: 在拍摄剧本里，这段要短得多。

sentences.en: You just said, I'm going to smash his face.
sentences.zh: 你当时只说了句“我要砸碎他的脸”。

sentences.en: And that was it, you know.
sentences.zh: 然后就没了，你知道的。

sentences.en: But in this deleted scene, Pam is going off.
sentences.zh: 但在这个删减片段里，潘彻底爆发了。

sentences.en: You do not mess with her, man.
sentences.zh: 你可千万别惹她，老兄。

sentences.en: I guess not.
sentences.zh: 我想也是吧。

sentences.en: Not after the night they had last night.
sentences.zh: 经历昨晚那种美妙夜晚之后更是如此。

sentences.en: The one night in heaven?
sentences.zh: 那如天堂般的一夜？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Wowzers.
sentences.zh: 哇噢。

sentences.en: Well, the tag for this episode brings us all the resolution we need.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这集的尾声给我们带来了我们需要的所有结局。

sentences.en: We're back in the conference room.
sentences.zh: 我们又回到了会议室。

sentences.en: Michael is proposing some more great ideas like a summer Christmas caroling sales event.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔又在提出一些绝妙的点子，比如夏日圣诞节唱诗销售活动。

sentences.en: He throws to Stanley.
sentences.zh: 他传球给斯坦利。

sentences.en: Stanley, what do you think?
sentences.zh: 斯坦利，你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: Stanley says, I think it might be your best idea yet.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利说，我觉得这可能是你迄今为止最好的主意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And then Phyllis kind of laughs and says, that's the dumbest thing I've ever heard.
sentences.zh: 然后菲利斯有点嘲笑地说，这是我听过最蠢的事。

sentences.en: Michael says, everybody out except Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔说，除了菲利斯，所有人都出去。

sentences.en: It's such a great tag.
sentences.zh: 这个结尾太棒了。

sentences.en: Guys, that was Did I Stutter?
sentences.zh: 伙计们，刚才那是《我刚才说结巴了吗》？

sentences.en: I can't believe I'm about to say this, Angela.
sentences.zh: 我真不敢相信我要说这话，安吉拉。

sentences.en: We are coming up on the end of season four.
sentences.zh: 我们快要迎来第四季的尾声了。

sentences.en: We've just got a few more episodes.
sentences.zh: 我们只剩下最后几集了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Last night I had to put a whole new disc in my DVD player.
sentences.zh: 昨晚我的DVD播放器得换一整张新光盘。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know it's serious when she's got to put a new disc in, guys.
sentences.zh: 大家注意，当她不得不换新光盘时，就说明事情严重了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I'm on my last disc for season four.
sentences.zh: 我正在看第四季的最后一张光盘。

sentences.en: It's going by so faSt.
sentences.zh: 时间过得太快了。

sentences.en: It's flying by.
sentences.zh: 时光飞逝。

sentences.zh: 我们下周将带着《招聘会》回归。

sentences.zh: 感谢布伦特·福雷斯特和莱斯利·大卫·贝克。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你们回短信跟我们讨论这一集。

sentences.zh: 还要感谢我这个数码囤积狂保留着拍摄剧本。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Thank you, Angela.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，安吉拉。

sentences.en: All right, you guys have a great week.
sentences.zh: 好了，祝大家有个愉快的一周。

sentences.zh: 我们下周见。
